_README: THE ASSISTANT'S NAVIGATION MAP — DRAFT, PENDING RODOLFO'S CURATION.
WHY THIS IS NOT IN Wasnie_Configuration_Guide.md. The guide documents BUSINESS RULES; this file
documents the app's ROUTING. They change for different reasons — a UI redesign moves every route
here and not one rule there — and mixing them means a screen rename dirties the handbook. Two
artefacts, two lifecycles.
HOW IT WAS BUILT (no value here was invented):
- `route` comes from the Angular router: WasnieUi/src/app/app.routes.ts and the per-feature
*.routes.ts files. These are the URLs the app actually serves.
- `label` comes from WasnieUi/src/assets/i18n/en.json, NOT from the templates. The templates say
{{ 'PLANS.ACTION_NEW' | translate }} — reading them would yield i18n keys, not the words a user
sees. en.json is the base language and holds the real button text.
WHAT WAS LEFT OUT ON PURPOSE, for Rodolfo to add back if he disagrees:
- Every route with an :id parameter (/plans/:planId, /plans/:planId/rules/new, /payees/:payeeId,
/quotas/:quotaId, /transactions/:id, /credits/:id, /pay-runs/:id, /payouts/:id,
/assignments/:assignmentId). A link the assistant emits must be CLICKABLE, and it has no id to
put in one — `/plans/:planId` is a broken link dressed as a working one. Those screens appear
under `actionsWithoutRoute` instead, named but not linked, which is exactly what the
no-invented-routes rule asks for when a route does not exist.
- /auth, /onboarding, /forbidden, /__design-system: not places to send a working user.
- /admin (labelled "Settings") and /integrations/hubspot/owners: administrator surfaces. Add
them if the assistant should guide admins there.
TO CURATE: trim entries a beginner should never receive, fix any intent -> screen mapping that is
wrong as a matter of business meaning, and correct any `purpose` that misdescribes the screen. The
routes and labels are facts from the code; the SELECTION and the wording are Rodolfo's call.

entries.label: Dashboard
entries.purpose: The home screen: overview of the account.

entries.label: Plans
entries.purpose: List every compensation plan. Open a plan from here to see or add its rules.

entries.label: New Plan
entries.purpose: Create a compensation plan: name, currency and period.

entries.label: Payees
entries.purpose: List the people who can earn commission.

entries.label: New Payee
entries.purpose: Add one payee by hand. The form's own title is "Add Payee".

entries.label: Import
entries.purpose: Add many payees at once from a file.

entries.label: Quotas
entries.purpose: List performance targets.

entries.label: New Quota
entries.purpose: Set a target for one payee within a plan period.

entries.label: Assignments
entries.purpose: List which payees are on which plans.

entries.label: New Assignment
entries.purpose: Put a payee on an active plan.

entries.label: Transactions
entries.purpose: List recorded sales.

entries.label: New Transaction
entries.purpose: Record one closed-won sale. The form's own title is "Record Transaction".

entries.label: Import
entries.purpose: Record many sales at once from a file.

entries.label: Categories
entries.purpose: Map a product SKU or name to a category so rules can filter by it.

entries.label: Credits
entries.purpose: Commission credits calculated from eligible pending transactions.

entries.label: Pay Runs
entries.purpose: Calculate and close commission periods.

entries.label: Payouts
entries.purpose: Review, approve and mark payouts as paid.

entries.label: Terminated accounts
entries.purpose: Payees who have left with a balance still open.

entries.label: Integrations
entries.purpose: Connect an external system such as a CRM.

entries.label: Subscription
entries.purpose: The account's plan and billing.

entries.label: Profile
entries.purpose: The signed-in user's own account settings.

entries.label: User manual
entries.purpose: The written user manual, inside the application and behind the login. Send the user here when they ask HOW to do something in Incentra and the documentation does not cover the procedure.

actionsWithoutRoute.label: Add Rule
actionsWithoutRoute.how: Open the plan from the Plans list, then use the Add Rule button on the plan's page.

actionsWithoutRoute.label: Plans
actionsWithoutRoute.how: Open the plan by name from the Plans list.

actionsWithoutRoute.label: Edit Payee
actionsWithoutRoute.how: Open the payee from the Payees list, then use Edit.

actionsWithoutRoute.label: Terminate Payee
actionsWithoutRoute.how: Open the payee from the Payees list, then use Terminate Payee.

actionsWithoutRoute.label: Add mapping
actionsWithoutRoute.how: Use the Add mapping button on the Categories screen — it opens a dialog, not a separate page.

actionsWithoutRoute.label: Calculate Pay Run
actionsWithoutRoute.how: Use the Calculate Pay Run action on the Pay Runs screen.

actionsWithoutRoute.label: Add adjustment
actionsWithoutRoute.how: Open the payee's account from Terminated accounts, then use Add adjustment.
